failure_modes.name: Entity_Coreference_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim asks about 'Patty Jenkins' but the retrieval in hop 3 returns information about 'Patti Scialfa' (a singer-songwriter inducted into Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2014). These are different people - Patty Jenkins is a film director (Monster, Wonder Woman), while Patti Scialfa is a musician married to Bruce Springsteen. The agent's query 'Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' was executed but the results discuss Patti Scialfa instead, and no passage about the actual Patty Jenkins (director) appears in any hop.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 explicitly identifies the missing entity: 'Patty Jenkins is not mentioned anywhere in the provided passages, so there is no information about her Hall of Fame status' and requests 'Information about Patty Jenkins' induction status into any Hall of Fame (likely relevant to film/entertainment)'. The hop 2 query targets this gap: 'Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' However, despite the well-formed query, no passage about Patty Jenkins (the film director) ever arrives in hop 2 or hop 3 - only Patti Scialfa appears, indicating a corpus/retrieval gap rather than agent fault.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 explicitly names the missing evidence: 'The Purple Rain Tour was performed by Prince and The Revolution (confirmed in passage [4]), but the passages contain no information about Prince's Hall of Fame induction status' and requests 'Information about Prince's induction status in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (or other relevant Hall of Fames)'. The hop 2 query targets this: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame?' However, across all three hops, no passage about Prince's Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction appears, indicating a retrieval/corpus coverage gap.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' This is a compound multi-part query bundling two distinct targets (Prince's status AND Patty Jenkins' status) in natural-language yes/no question form, rather than entity-focused keyword queries that retrievers handle well.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' Identical to hop 2 - compound multi-part natural-language yes/no question bundling two targets instead of entity-focused retrieval terms.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: The queries for hop 2 and hop 3 are identical: both ask 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' with no change in wording, no refinement based on hop 2 results, and no substantive advancement of the search strategy.
